text:
Ask!
Then Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, who was intent on the bodhisattva’s courage,
who was diligent in purifying his practice,
whose mind was illuminated by the bodhisattva’s power of illumination,
whose mind was firm, invincible, and unassailable by others,
whose mind was undaunted by the excellent armor of the bodhisattva’s aspiration,
who was diligent in abiding in and increasing the bodhisattva’s firm intention,
who had the intention of fully receiving the rain of the bodhisattva’s cloud of conduct,
He was endowed with an inexhaustible mind that was like a cloud of Dharma rain for bodhisattvas.
He had actualized the aspiration to enter all the qualities of bodhisattvas.
He was dedicated to giving himself to all beings, who were like his own children, and he wanted to rescue all beings from the great wilderness of saṃsāra.
He was never satisfied with seeing,
hearing,
or serving spiritual friends.
He was endowed with the generation of immeasurable service to the Dharma.
He bowed his head to the feet of the monk Lovely to Behold,
The monk Darśanamudgara circumambulated the monk Darśanārtha many hundreds of thousands of times,
and looked at him again and again.
Then he left the presence of the monk Darśanārtha.
